name: Roro Eduaru
source:
Roro is a dancer and summoner who has come to the capital from a foreign country far to the south to study.

Roro is the daughter of a foreign royal family. Female royals have inherited the power to summon demons by dancing for generations. A tradition since ancient times, members of the royal family are required to marry a person of the opposite sex who has high magical power so as to not weaken their royal blood.

Such is the case for Roro, aside from going to the royal capital to study she is also on the lookout for someone of the opposite sex who possesses high magical power.

When she meets [url=/c42047]Tomohiro[/url] who produces semen that amplifies magic power when consumed, she unequivocally decides that he is the best match for her.

With a cheerful personality she approaches Tomohiro Aggressively.

[Translated from [url=https://hadashi.product.co.jp/3ping/char.html]the game's Official Homepage[/url].]
